# BRC-62: Background Evaluation Extended Format (BEEF)

Fixture body for the refresh tests.

## Abstract

BEEF is a binary format for conveying a transaction together with the merkle
proofs of its inputs, so a recipient can verify it without a lookup service.

## Requirements

A valid BEEF stream MUST begin with the magic prefix `0100BEEF` and MUST carry
a BUMP merkle proof for every input that is not provided in full.
